protocolRefs.multiCallChain: SAX XML document-write lifecycle: obtain a document reference (e.g. via Create document/OPEN DOCUMENT) -> optionally SAX SET XML DECLARATION and document-level SAX ADD XML DOCTYPE/PROCESSING INSTRUCTION/COMMENT calls -> SAX OPEN XML ELEMENT / SAX ADD XML ELEMENT VALUE / SAX ADD XML CDATA for element content (nested opens require matching SAX CLOSE XML ELEMENT) -> CLOSE DOCUMENT.

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Writes a document-level XML processing instruction (e.g. an xml-stylesheet declaration) into the SAX document referenced by document.
